title: Odile and the Sigil Anew
author: Mara Lockridge
blurb: Edmund Quintana, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
